description: Unified Hazard (ISO 26262), SOTIF Triggering Conditions (ISO 21448), Cybersecurity Threats (ISO/SAE 21434), and AI Weaknesses (ISO/PAS 8800 / EU AI Act) Catalog.

functional_safety_hazards.malfunction: Unintended excessive steering torque command during automated driving.
functional_safety_hazards.operational_scenario: Vehicle cruising at 130 km/h on highway curve adjacent to guardrail.
functional_safety_hazards.safety_goal: Prevent unintended lateral steering torque exceeding 3.0 Nm with FTTI <= 20ms.

functional_safety_hazards.malfunction: Sudden unannounced loss of lane centering control during curve.
functional_safety_hazards.operational_scenario: Vehicle navigating R=300m curve at 120 km/h without driver hands on wheel.
functional_safety_hazards.safety_goal: Maintain lateral path tracking or execute graceful fail-operational takeover within 500ms.

functional_safety_hazards.malfunction: False positive emergency braking command in open highway.
functional_safety_hazards.operational_scenario: Vehicle cruising at 130 km/h with trailing 40-ton truck at 25m distance.
functional_safety_hazards.safety_goal: Prevent deceleration exceeding 2.0 m/s2 in the absence of valid collision target.

functional_safety_hazards.malfunction: Unintended sustained acceleration command / throttle stuck during traffic queue approach.
functional_safety_hazards.operational_scenario: Vehicle approaching slow/stopped queue at 80 km/h on wet motorway.
functional_safety_hazards.safety_goal: Inhibit unintended propulsion torque and force friction brake override with FTTI <= 50ms.

functional_safety_hazards.malfunction: Silent disengagement of automated steering control without transition demand or acoustic warning.
functional_safety_hazards.operational_scenario: Level 3 operation at 110 km/h while driver is lawfully engaged in non-driving secondary activity.
functional_safety_hazards.safety_goal: Ensure multi-modal acoustic, optical, and haptic transition demand precedes any deactivation by at least 10s or maintain fail-operational trajectory.

sotif_triggering_conditions.phenomenon: Low sun elevation (< 5 deg) causing front camera sensor blooming.
sotif_triggering_conditions.functional_insufficiency: Perception network fails to extract white dashed lane markings.
sotif_triggering_conditions.consequence: Lateral lane drift unless radar/lidar fusion or map boundary holds trajectory.

sotif_triggering_conditions.phenomenon: Overlapping faded permanent white markings and temporary orange/yellow lines.
sotif_triggering_conditions.functional_insufficiency: Neural network lane boundary tracker prioritizes incorrect line.
sotif_triggering_conditions.consequence: Vehicle steers towards barrier or adjacent traffic.

sotif_triggering_conditions.phenomenon: Dense water spray plume from overtaking commercial truck.
sotif_triggering_conditions.functional_insufficiency: Optical camera occlusion combined with radar clutter reflection.
sotif_triggering_conditions.consequence: Loss of target track or erroneous close cut-in prediction.

sotif_triggering_conditions.phenomenon: Radar electromagnetic multipath bouncing off metallic barrier and road surface.
sotif_triggering_conditions.functional_insufficiency: Ghost stationary obstacle synthesized directly in ego lane path.

sotif_triggering_conditions.phenomenon: Partial salt crust or insect smear obscuring narrow-FOV front telephoto camera.
sotif_triggering_conditions.functional_insufficiency: Reduced detection range for distant obstacles (150m down to 60m) without complete black-out fault.
sotif_triggering_conditions.consequence: Late emergency braking upon high-speed closing target.

cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.vulnerability: Unauthenticated frame broadcast on vehicle chassis bus.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.threat_scenario: Adversary injects forged CAN-FD frames commanding maximum lateral steering torque.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.damage_scenario: Immediate unintended lane departure and collision (Safety impact: S3, Financial: High).
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.cybersecurity_goal: Ensure authenticity, integrity, and anti-replay of steering commands via AUTOSAR SecOC AES-128 CMAC and monotonic Freshness Value.

cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.vulnerability: Insecure download channel or compromised cloud repository.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.threat_scenario: Malicious actor replaces neural network weights or control binary with weaponized payload during OTA staging.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.damage_scenario: System-wide compromise of driving automation logic (Safety impact: S3, Operational: Fleetwide).
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.cybersecurity_goal: Validate cryptographic signatures using Hardware Root of Trust and verify RXSWIN match in compliance with UN Regulation No. 156.

cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.threat_scenario: Attacker broadcasts simulated GPS satellite signals to spoof vehicle into false ODD or geofence boundary.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.damage_scenario: System activates outside certified operational design domain.
cybersecurity_threat_scenarios.cybersecurity_goal: Cross-validate GNSS position against visual odometry, wheel speed dead reckoning, and HD map feature localization.

ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.weakness: Out-of-distribution road surface textures under partial slush/snow.
ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.mitigation: Epistemic uncertainty head with rejection gating and handover to classical radar filter.

ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.weakness: Quantization loss on small bounding boxes (> 150m distant vehicles).
ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.mitigation: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) with loss penalty on distant high-speed vehicles.

ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.weakness: Adversarial high-contrast perturbation sticker causing speed limit 30 sign to be classified as 80.
ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.mitigation: Multi-frame temporal consistency filtering and digital map speed limit plausibility bounds.

ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.weakness: Underrepresentation of non-standard pedestrian postures (wheelchairs, motorized scooters, reflective safety vests).
ai_safety_weaknesses_iso8800.mitigation: Synthetic diffusion data augmentation and EU AI Act Article 10 balanced demographic data audit.
